gaps.what: Pages read: 2 of a 1-2 page budget. The 25,000 km2 southern loss of 1895, the Equatoria fringe in the DRC and Uganda, Suakin and Wadi Halfa after 1885, and the extent of the Khalifa's remnant in 1899 are not on the pages
No infobox area on either page, so the area check against Cliopatria's 2.33 M km2 was not possible
Founding date and the borders of the protectorate years 1889-1925 are not on the pages; keyframe 1890..1927 is the 1885 shape at confidence 1
The 30,000 km2 loss of 1890 and the borders of the protectorate years 1895-1925 are not on the pages; no infobox area

Eritrean War of Independence (rebel-held land before 1991), the 1942 and 1944 Anglo-Ethiopian Agreements, the 1954 handover of the Haud and Reserved Area, the 1964 border war and the Ilemi triangle are not covered; rulers omitted
The 'about a quarter of Eritrea's territory' held by Ethiopia in May 2000 is not located on the page; the Eritrean occupation of northern Tigray has no end date (closed at 2024)
Written from the Tigray War page only; no TPLF article opened (wikipedia and wikidata null); the Amhara-held west is not carved out of the TDF-held area

problems: Cliopatria's Majeerteen (to 1889) and Hobyo (to 1894) rows end at the Italian protectorate treaties, while the sultans reigned to 1927 and 1925; the dossiers run to 1927 and 1925 with new keyframes, and the Italian Africa dossier (af-08) should carry vassal_start/vassal_end for both (April 1889 to late 1927; 8 February 1889 to October 1925). Cliopatria's Italian Africa shapes already cover both sultanates from 1890 and 1895, so the two overlap until Italian Africa is trimmed or tinted.

Cliopatria's British Africa shape for 1941 contains all of Ethiopia (about 4,740 cells) and Eritrea; the ethiopia dossier starts in 1941 (Cliopatria 1942) and the British Africa dossier should trim it.

The schema has no event type for 'becomes a protectorate / federal unit' in the vassal's own dossier; 'rename' events carry those status captions (Majeerteen 1889, Hobyo 1889, Ethiopia 1962 and the regime changes 1974, 1975, 1987, 1991, 1995).

Cliopatria's Khedivate of Egypt (1880-1884, 3.0 M km2) still covers the Sudan while the Mahdist State dossier starts in 1881; the Mahdist gains of 1882, 1883 and 1885 name khedivate-of-egypt as counterpart and need the matching losses.
ethiopia identity.end is 2026 (current year) while Cliopatria's row ends in 2024; no dissolve event, the state being alive.
A rebel dossier was added (tigray-people-s-liberation-front, type rebel) from one page, with wikipedia/wikidata null.
